The '''Laguna Caves''' were caves on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and part of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] racetrack. Rescue teams and scavengers did not go in the Laguna caves because there was a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] inhabiting them.<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />

==History==
[[File:Finalmoments.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Tyerell's final moments]]

During the [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] racer [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]] crashed in this caves, [[Death/Legends|dying]] instantly.<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
